freeEntry.text: Entry not required to be paid, but some challenges are Vocal+ members only (a paid subscription)
freeEntry.quote: You're not required to pay to enter Vocal's Challenges. However, some Challenges will only be open to Vocal+ members.

prize.quote: Prize amounts live on each challenge page; the FAQ states only that cash prizes are paid via Stripe.

deadline.quote: Per challenge; not stated in the FAQ.

eligibility.text: 13+, active account, resident in a country where Stripe is available (FAQ says 32 countries)
eligibility.quote: you must be over the age of 13, have an active Vocal account ... and be residing in a country where Stripe is available at time of entry

aiPolicy.quote: Not addressed in the FAQ; each challenge sets its own rules.

payout.text: Cash prizes paid to a Stripe account
payout.quote: If the Challenge has a cash prize, we'll send the prize money to your Stripe account.

summary: Free entry is confirmed only in the negative sense: no payment is required for most challenges, but Vocal+ exclusives require a paid membership. Cash is paid via Stripe. The FAQ is marked 'updated 5 years ago', so treat its country count as stale and read the individual challenge.
flags: FAQ is five years old; country list and platform terms may have changed.
Some challenges require a paid Vocal+ membership.
Per-challenge prize and AI rules were not verified in this pass.
